title: gx10 — GB10 + vLLM
description: GB10, vLLM (Kolibri-1) and host telemetry for gx10. Replaces the upstream DGX Spark vLLM dashboard for day-to-day use.

panels.title: UNIFIED MEMORY USED
panels.description: GB10 shares one memory pool between CPU and GPU; nvidia-smi reports no VRAM.

panels.title: GPU / MEMORY-CONTROLLER UTILIZATION
panels.description: Memory-controller utilization near 100% with GPU below it means bandwidth-bound decode — the expected shape for batch-1 LLM inference.

panels.title: THROTTLE REASONS
panels.description: 1 = actively throttling. Sustained sw power cap means the card is at its limit.

panels.title: PREFILL TOK/S (10m)
panels.description: Newly computed (not prefix-cached) prompt tokens per second of prefill time, over requests that FINISHED in the last 10 min — vLLM records it at completion. Recipe measured ~5.3k tok/s at 21k context, ~580 averaged over a 978k fill.

panels.title: DECODE TOK/S PER STREAM
panels.description: 1 / mean inter-token latency: live, updated every decode step. Kolibri-1 NVFP4 on GB10: ~50 tok/s at 1 stream, ~30 each at 4.

panels.title: GENERATED TOK/S (ALL)
panels.description: Aggregate output tokens per second across all running requests (counter-based, live). ~128 tok/s with 4 concurrent reasoning streams.

panels.title: PREFIX CACHE HIT RATE
panels.description: Since server start. Agent loops resend the whole conversation each turn, so this should sit high; low means every turn pays a cold prefill.

panels.title: KV CACHE USAGE
panels.description: Share of the pinned KV pool (KV_CACHE_GIB=24, ~2.36M tokens) in use.

panels.title: REQUESTS WAITING
panels.description: Non-zero means all sequence slots or the KV pool are full.

panels.title: THROUGHPUT (AGGREGATE)
panels.description: Wall-clock token rates across all streams. Cached prompt tokens are served from the prefix cache without recompute.

panels.title: LATENCY
panels.description: TTFT is dominated by prefill: long cold prompts take minutes at 1M.

panels.title: KV CACHE / PREEMPTIONS
panels.description: Preemptions mean the KV pool ran out and a request was evicted and recomputed.

panels.title: PROMPT LENGTH (CONTEXT PER REQUEST)
panels.description: How much context the agents actually send. Histogram buckets, so values are bucket-bounded; max_model_len is 1,048,576.

panels.title: REQUEST PHASES (p50)
panels.description: Long decode with reasoning on: Kolibri thinks before tool calls (server default reasoning_effort=medium).

panels.title: TOOL-CALL PARSER
panels.description: Tool-call parser invocations per minute (kolibri1 Hermes-style parser).
